blocks.html: The Drawing Tools let you mark up the map with shapes, freehand sketches and briefing graphics. Create a shape, then tap it to open its radial menu and Details.

slides.title: Draw a circle or ellipse
slides.html: Select the Circle or Ellipse icon, tap the centre, then tap again to set the radius or edge. Open Details to set exact radius, rings, colour and line thickness; Label and Center toggle the on-map markers.

slides.title: Draw a rectangle
slides.html: Select the Rectangle icon, then tap three corners to set width, length and depth. In Details, tick Tactical Overlay to colour-code the structure: white is the front, black the back.

slides.title: Draw a free-form polygon or polyline
slides.html: Select the Free Form icon and tap to drop each vertex. Tap the first vertex to close a polygon, or select End Shape for an open polyline. Use Undo to remove the last link.

slides.title: Sketch freehand with Telestrate
slides.html: Select the Telestrate icon to draw freehand with a finger or stylus; map scrolling is locked while it is on. Select Undo to remove the last stroke, or End to save the sketch as one multi-polyline.

slides.title: Place briefing graphics
slides.html: Briefing graphics and tactical symbols are placed like ordinary shapes: pick the symbol type, then draw it on the map. The chosen type is listed in the shape's Details panel, where you can change or clear it.

slides.title: Add a minimum safe distance zone
slides.html: On a placed shape, select Minimum Safe Distance from its radial menu. Set the Range and tick Enabled to draw a buffer zone around the shape's border. Save it to Favorites with + to reuse it on other shapes.
